name: Himi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Himi city emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a disc above curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Himi, a city in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 September 1958.

features.role: Himi city emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a disc above curved strokes
